name: 無底板頁首列＋標誌左、導覽與按鈕右，往下捲動隱藏
desc: 沒有底板的整列頁首，標誌與導覽元素直接放在頁面上；固定在頂端，往下捲動隱藏、往上捲動滑回。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端。頁首沒有底板，標誌與導覽連結、功能區各自直接放在頁面上。標誌在左，導覽連結與功能區靠右，所有元素垂直置中排成一列；標誌與功能區分別靠近畫面左右邊緣，只保留少量邊距，比頁面內容寬度更寬。功能區可放一個主要按鈕，沒有時省略。往下捲動時頁首往上滑出隱藏，往上捲動時滑回出現，滑回時疊在內容上方。
mobile: 頁首上只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，同樣沒有底板；導覽連結與功能區收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，展開蓋住整個畫面的選單面板，標誌留在原位，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕；導覽連結在面板裡直向排列並靠左，有子項目的連結旁有展開符號，點擊後在原位展開子連結；主要按鈕放在導覽連結下方並橫跨面板內容寬度；面板最下方可放小型文字連結，沒有時省略。往下捲動隱藏、往上捲動滑回的行為保留。

en.name: Bare header bar with logo left, navigation and button right, hides on scroll down
en.desc: A full-width header with no backing panel, its elements placed directly on the page; fixed to the top, it slides away when scrolling down and slides back when scrolling up.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport. The header has no backing panel; the logo, the navigation links and the actions group sit directly on the page. Place the logo on the left, with the navigation links and the actions group on the right, all vertically centered in one row; the logo and the actions group sit close to the left and right edges of the viewport with only a small margin, wider than the page content width. Optionally place one primary button in the actions group; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. When scrolling down, the header slides up out of view; when scrolling up, it slides back in, overlaying the content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: Only the logo on the left and a menu button on the right stay in the header, still with no backing panel; the navigation links and the actions group move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button opens a menu panel covering the whole viewport, the logo stays in place and the menu button turns into a close button; the navigation links are stacked vertically and left-aligned in the panel, links with sub-items show an expand symbol and expand their sub-links in place when tapped; the primary button sits below the navigation links, spanning the panel's content width; small text links may be placed at the very bottom of the panel, omitted when there is no content. The hide-on-scroll-down, slide-back-on-scroll-up behavior is kept.
